dict.string: Daisy records your microphone so it can transcribe and summarize your meetings. Audio stays on your device.
Daisy records this computer's audio (the people you're meeting with) so it can transcribe and summarize your meetings. Audio stays on your device.
Daisy uses Bluetooth to wake your paired phone when a recording is ready for it. Your meetings stay on your devices.
Daisy uses your local network to find and sync with your paired phone. Your meetings stay on your devices.
